pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

2. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

4. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

6. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

7. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language School.

8. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

9. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

10. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

11. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a describing word

13. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

14. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.

15. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
